## TemplateEngine.validateBlockKeyboardAttributes() method

Validates attributes on `<keyboard>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockKeyboardAttributes(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

## Remarks

Allowed attributes are `lang` and `type`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const result = TemplateEngine.validateBlockKeyboardAttributes(`<keyboard type="bottom">A, B</keyboard>`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }
```
